title: Dave Valentin Light Struck CD 1986 GRP Jazz Flute Angela Bofill Latin
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Dave Valentin - Light Struck (GRP Records GRP-D-9537, 1986). Digitally mixed and mastered, GRP Digital Master. Compact disc manufactured in Japan.

With special guest Angela Bofill. Featuring Lincoln Goines, Bill O'Connell, Robert Ameen, Rafael De Jesus, Robert Gonzalez, Mitchel Forman, Buddy Williams and Francisco Centeno. Produced by Dave Valentin and Steven Miller; executive producers Dave Grusin and Larry Rosen.

8 tracks:
1. Miss V
2. Can't Change My Heart
3. Grandslam
4. The Village
5. AM-FM
6. Chris-Cross
7. Prince of Wands
8. Prelude To A Kiss

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
